content.v: 芭芭雅嘎是东斯拉夫童话中的传奇女巫，鸡脚小屋是她最鲜明的标志之一。在《蕾卡的移动工坊》(REKA)中，玩家将扮演她的学徒蕾卡，走进森林，亲手 建造 一间能陪自己旅行的小屋。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793773372_187721.png
在不同版本的童话里，芭芭雅嘎有着不同的面貌。她有时威胁来访者，有时为他们设下考验，也可能提供指引与帮助。她的小屋同样古怪：它立在鸡脚上，在一些故事中会应来访者的请求转过身，把门朝向对方。
《蕾卡的移动工坊》是一款融合探索、建造与制作玩法的单人冒险游戏。玩家可以跟随芭芭雅嘎修习巫术，在秋日林地采集材料、回应村民的委托，发现隐藏在森林里的秘密。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793773372_780667.png
传说里令人好奇的鸡脚小屋，在游戏中也成为可以亲手搭建和布置的家。玩家可以摆放家具、装饰内景，让小屋呈现自己的样子。它会陪伴玩家穿行森林、沼泽与村庄，也是在探索之后可以回来的落脚点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793773372_851486.png
免费中文 Demo 可体验故事第一章。《蕾卡的移动工坊》1.0 正式版已于 2026 年 10 月 26 日在 Steam 发售，加入官方简体中文支持，并带来完整故事。
《蕾卡的移动工坊》由 Emberstorm Entertainment 开发，Fireshine Games 与亚洲发行商松竹游戏共同发行。
玩家可前往 Steam 商店页面免费试玩中文 Demo，或购买 1.0 正式版，继续体验蕾卡的完整冒险。

news.summary: Jacek Rozenek was the voice of Geralt in all previous Polish-language Witcher releases, and CD Projekt wanted

content.v: Conversations about the ethical use of AI in game development are about to get a whole lot more difficult as Game File reports that CD Projekt worked with AI company Respeecher to modify the game's Polish voice actor for the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt .

The actor, Jacek Rozenek , voiced Geralt in the Polish editions of all the Witcher games, including The Witcher 3 and its two expansions, and the Game File report says his performances are highly regarded. But in 2019, he suffered a stroke that left him temporarily unable to speak; by 2021 he had rehabilitated enough to be able to provide some new lines for The Witcher 3's next-gen update , but the process left him "exhausted."

Still, he continued to train and was eventually able to return to work, and when CD Projekt decided to make a new Witcher 3 expansion it wanted him back for the role. But the stroke, and the passage of time, had left Rozenek's voice noticeably changed. Given that Songs of the Past will occur in the midst of The Witcher 3, that shift in tone—"lower [and] gruffer," according to Game File's Stephen Totilo—presented a problem.

So with Rozenek's permission, CD Projekt approached AI voice company Respeecher to rework his voice for the game. Rozenek is still providing the voice of Geralt in the Polish version of the expansion, but Respeecher is adjusting it to make him sound like he did a decade ago.
"The brief was simple: make Jacek’s voice sound alive, rich and young, like in the original game," synthetic speech artist Dmytro Vasylets said.

"Getting there took dozens of hours, training models, going through the details with the CDPR team, and dealing with AI artifacts that never fully disappear. The hardest part was Jacek’s emotional range: the half-tones, shouts, groans, anger, fear and laughter. Capturing all of that at the highest audio quality was the real challenge. I’d like to think we pulled it off."

Rozenek said he feels "very good" about returning to the role of Geralt because he's so familiar with the character; the issue was merely that his voice was different. Because of that, he's all in favor of the AI treatment: "The point is that this voice should be as close as possible to my voice from 12 years ago," he said. "I have great trust…for the creators of this game."

This isn't CD Projekt's first time working with Respeecher: It previously used the company to reproduce the voice of Miłogost Reczek , who portrayed Viktor Vektor and Vesemir in the Polish releases of Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3. Reczek died in 2021; in that case as well, CD Projekt had the family's blessing to use an AI recreation of the actor's voice.

The use of generative AI in voice acting is an incredibly thorny issue, one that voice actors have gone to great lengths to maintain some control over . CD Projekt itself has been ambivalent about AI ; localization producer Mikołaj Szwed told Game File that "as a person working with voice actors over all the regions in the world, this is a big concern," although he added that "this was a special case" caused by Rozenek's health problems. The studio is not planning to do anything similar with the voice of Doug Cockle, who portrays Geralt in the English releases of The Witcher games, Szwed said; Rozenek's voice would also not be altered in any hypothetical future Witcher games set later in the timeline, because the vocal change would be fine: "It’s more about this specific situation here, where we have both the voice from 12 years ago and from now next to each other."

Interestingly, the news of Rozenek's AI-powered vocal overhaul comes just one day after veteran voice actor Stephen Russell appeared in a Nightdive podcast and discussed returning to the role of Garrett in the upcoming Thief: The Dark Project remaster. It's been more than 20 years since Russell last portrayed the character, in 2004's Thief: Deadly Shadows, which meant he had to be more conscious of his pitch and delivery while working on content for the new Tarnished Mirror expansion.

But while "the equipment changes," as Russell said, Rozenek's stroke was more directly damaging: Totilo said his untouched voice in the expansion "sounds deep and gravelly, noticeably rougher than his recordings for the original game," while the AI-edited voice is much closer to Rozenek's voice as it was a decade ago.

news.title: 在打击《Helldivers 2》中的“作弊”模组并再次遭受 Steam 评论打击后，Arrowhead 计划进行修补程序，以允许无害的化妆品
news.summary: The move to a better anti-cheat has not been wholly embraced by players.

content.v: Helldivers 2, in the running for the most review-bombed game in history, got another Steam beating a few weeks back when Arrowhead announced a change in anti-cheat services that would break or disallow existing mods.

The goal with the switch from GameGuard to Easy Anti-Cheat, as the studio explained at the time , was to combat mods that "create unfair advantages or negatively impact others," but it also acknowledged that mods it has no problems with, like cosmetic add-ons, would also be affected. The news went over like a lead balloon, prompting over 10,000 fresh negative Steam reviews and a "mostly negative" recent rating.

Skimming the last few weeks of ratings, negative reviewers are either miffed about their broken mods, new and old bugs, or the perception that Arrowhead is attacking modders instead of fixing bugs. There was no reality where a community notorious for intensely boycotting everything it finds annoying was going to embrace stricter modding oversight, but Arrowhead did address the outcry in its latest Helldivers 2 developer blog .

"We added Easy Anti-Cheat for one reason: to reduce the number of cheaters joining your missions and ruining the experience. On that front, we think we’re taking steps in the right direction," the blog read. "However, we do see that this change means that some PC players lost the use of fan-made game mods. While all mods are not officially supported, we have been reviewing how the code changes disabled cosmetic non-gameplay mods. This has resulted in adjustments that should allow some cosmetic mods to be functional with our next hotfix."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HxskXfdXMYUvr7Qm5mh5Wg-1920-80.jpg

Mod restriction is a prickly topic for Helldivers 2, which is both a perfectly valid candidate for mods as a purely PvE game, but also a live service with real-money currency and DLC. A common form of cheating in Helldivers 2 is to use mods to farm (or straight up spawn) premium Super Credits that are supposed to be rare. Another is to alter weapon or enemy behavior in ways that are unfair to vanilla teammates trying to play normally, or in some cases cause client crashes.

I'm guessing Arrowhead is slightly more concerned about the folks farming free currency at rapid speeds than the ones with infinite ammo cheats, but it won't be budging on outlawing gameplay-altering mods that, "from a technical perspective, are indistinguishable from an attempt to cheat."

But that's not the only thing the Reddit crowd is pissed about: The studio also acknowledged that promised improvements to hellpod steering and stratagem bouncing have taken longer than planned because they "require substantial adjustments to both mechanics while taking into account all edge cases," copped to missing patch dates on its current roadmap, and apologized for overselling the arrival of bug caves on more map types as a "new biome" on the same roadmap.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kiGWSdukACqg8RELAGC46k-1920-80.jpg

"Your input matters and we’re sorry this roadmap wasn’t as accurate as it should have been, Helldivers. While we aren’t announcing a date for it in this article, our next roadmap will demonstrate the impact of your feedback."
Looking ahead, Arrowhead shared some improvements coming in early December:

Good stuff, except I have read that first bullet point three times now and still can't decide what it means. I think it means that mobility packs now pair nicely with objectives that require carrying large objects, like SEAF artillery missiles, but I'm just not sure. I suppose they did say they're working on clarity.

news.summary: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra, Amy Hennig's Captain America/Black Panther game, is reportedly close to being fini

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/04/marvel-1780614544087.jpg
Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra, Amy Hennig's Captain America/Black Panther game, is reportedly close to being finished, but it could be extremely compromised.

According to a new report from Kotaku , Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra is "close to done." The news comes hours after rumors began spread online that the game was canceled, with an official announcement coming soon. According to Kotaku and Bloomberg's Jason Schreier, Skydancer leadership told staff via Slack that this is not the case and that they should continue business as usual.

Kotaku's report went on to describe the game's development as difficult, which should come as no surprise to anyone who's been following its journey. The title was announced in 2024 and has been delayed several times, with little to no news or footage beyond that.

Kotaku claims that Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra initially began as a Netflix game, but was later expanded for consoles and PC. Unfortunately, the title is reportedly "light on gameplay," with most of the action mapped to one button and the experience lacking "significant interactivity."

The project has also allegedly gone well over budget, and as a result, has had to "significantly" scale back from its original vision in terms of content and length. As of right now, we have no idea when Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra will release, but if it really is nearing the finish line, we could see something next year. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem like the game will be a hyper-engaging action/adventure title with riveting action, from the sound of it.

This is purely speculative, but based on the details from Kotaku's report, it wouldn't be surprising if this is more along the lines of a Quantic Dream experience like Heavy Rain or Detroit: Become Human, with some combat sprinkled in. Either way, if fans were hoping for something like Marvel's Spider-Man, but with Captain America and Black Panther, they may end up pretty disappointed.

Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra is meant to be director Amy Hennig's first proper game since Uncharted 3 in 2011. Although she has consulted and helped out on some other games like Forspoken over the years, Hennig hasn't led a new game since Uncharted 3. She was reportedly ousted from Naughty Dog in the early 2010s after Uncharted 4 was struggling to meet internal expectations. She then went to EA, where she was meant to lead a new Star Wars game with Visceral Games, but the studio was shut down and the project was scrapped. Now, she's heading up this Marvel game... and we'll just have to wait and see how it turns out.

news.summary: A new report says that video evidence of the affair exists, but was swept under the rug.

content.v: Days after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy (China denies any espionage ), The New York Times has reported new claims that Huang also had an affair with an executive who reports to him: Kimberly Powell, an Nvidia VP who oversees the company's healthcare tech-related efforts.
NYT cites five sources who work at the company, and says that it is aware of, but has not seen, video evidence of the affair.
It's a story you could see playing out in a film noir thriller.

According to NYT's sources, Huang and Powell were seen "being affectionate" at a hotel in the vicinity of an Nvidia conference earlier this year. A bystander allegedly captured a video of the interaction, but according to the report was made an offer by security personnel—details unknown—in return for signing an NDA.

Nvidia's board of directors is investigating the national security concerns raised by the affair Huang disclosed over the weekend, and The Wall Street Journal reported today that the board is preparing to oust the CEO.
At the time of writing, the company has not commented on this new allegation. PC Gamer has reached out.

news.title: Giana Sisters 开发商 Black Forest Games 收购了 Embracer：“过去十年中一些最好的游戏来自 50 人的团队，而不是 500 人”
news.summary: According to the press release, "THQ Nordic and Black Forest Games continue to collaborate on game development

content.v: Black Forest Games, German developer of early Kickstarter success Giana Sisters: Twisted Dreams, as well as remakes of the first two Destroy All Humans games, and, er, Bubsy: The Woolies Strike Back, has announced it's leaving THQ Nordic after nine years within the Embracer Group subsidiary.

Following a management buyout, Black Forest has founded an indie studio group called Third Signal. "Some of the best games of the last decade came from teams of fifty, not five hundred," said Third Signal's founder and CEO Andreas Tobler. "Black Forest Games is one of them, and the right studio to launch Third Signal. Our vision is to build a developer-driven group and give teams the independence, resources and creative freedom to continue their creative legacy and bring their own ideas to life."

Black Forest Games was founded by staff of Spellbound Entertainment, creator of the Desperados series and Arcania: Gothic 4 before being closed in 2012. As Black Forest Games they mostly worked on revivals of existing series, and were developing a game based on the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles comic The Last Ronin before it was canceled and then revived as a Platinum joint . They were also one of the studios under Embracer's umbrella hit with layoffs in 2024 , losing roughly 50 staff.

"We are grateful to THQ Nordic and Embracer for nine good years and the games we made together," said managing director Adrian Goersch. "Now, we're excited to shape our own future as owners again, to work on an exciting new project with a great team and strong partners behind us."

news.title: 一位死亡金属吉他手永远痴迷于《魔兽世界》，他用 Steam Deck 将它带到了舞台上
news.summary: World of Warcraft Forever is off to a monumental start, with more players wandering Azeroth than ever before.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/15/wowoo-1789495563832.png

World of Warcraft Forever is off to a monumental start, with more players wandering Azeroth than ever before. And at least one death metal guitarist can't put it down long enough to watch his opener play.

Death metal band Archspire posted a video to Instagram, overlaid with text that reads, "POV World of Warcraft Forever comes out the same day as the show," as the camera shows a Steam Deck with an undead Warlock running around with his voidwalker. The caption carries on the bit, saying, "When your set starts at 9:00 but you just zoned into Undercity to pick up your Voidwalker quest so you can pet-tank your way through Fenris Isle."

I get the appeal, some of the quests in Fenris Isle are absolutely brutal if you don't have anyone else in your party, so getting a purple blob that can tank it for you really is exciting. It doesn't hurt that WoW Forever runs incredibly on a handheld, either.

WoW Forever's newfound controller support and lightweight system requirements make it a natural match for handheld gaming PCs. I've tested the game on both the Xbox Ally X and the MSI Claw 8 EX AI+ , and both have been able to handle the game at pretty high settings without dipping below 60 fps. I haven't played the game on the Steam Deck quite yet, but at least from Archspire's Instagram post, it seems to be running just fine.

Archspire's guitarist is also not the only Death Metaller who loves WoW. IGN interviewed Cannibal Corpse way back in 2008 , and when we asked George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher about his love for the game, he told us, "It is true, I am obsessed with WOW! I have 70 level 70 characters. I play HORDE side ONLY. I hate the Alliance with a passion!"

Corpsegrinder also told us a story about how he was inundated with messages from fans, saying, "I did another interview where I said my Rogue's name and the server I played on, and then I started getting tells in game. A LOT OF TELLS. I was getting bombarded even when I was raiding, so I transferred him off the server and changed his name. I loved talking to people who were into Cannibal Corpse, but it was getting so I logged in and couldn't play, because all I did was exchange tells with people."

A lot has changed since 2008, but WoW Forever is looking to recapture some of that old-school WoW magic. And just based on how many people are playing the game, Blizzard seems to have pulled it off, even though they've run into some hurdles with gold rewards and dungeon experience .

news.title: 在粉丝发现“新媒体”列表后，新的《洛克人传奇》游戏、电影或电视剧可能正在制作中
news.summary: A now-deleted listing for ‘Mega Man Legends — New Media’ was spotted on a ‘What’s Shooting’ page for ACTRA Tor

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/11/mega-man-legends-project-spotted-1794436810221.jpg

A now-deleted listing for ‘Mega Man Legends — New Media’ was spotted on a ‘What’s Shooting’ page for ACTRA Toronto, hinting that a new game, film, or TV series in the franchise's 'Legends' series is in the works.

Although it’s since been deleted, several publications were able to screenshot the listing before it was taken down. The project’s start date was listed as September 14, 2026, with an end date of December 1, 2026. Casting was listed as “in-house.”

ACTRA Toronto’s What’s Shooting page is a public database that compiles ongoing projects that are registered with Canada’s performers’ union, the Alliance of Canadian Cinema, Television and Radio Artists. The Mega Man project’s ‘New Media’ label is especially intriguing, as this doesn’t necessarily denote that a new game is being made; rather, it’s vague enough to encompass any manner of projects, including movies or TV shows.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/11/mega-man-project-large-1794436020345.png

A Mega Man Legends movie isn’t out of the question, especially given Capcom’s recent foray into the world of Hollywood films. Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil adaptation was wildly successful, and hopes are high for a sequel to Legendary’s Street Fighter flick. In fact, Capcom has been working toward a screen adaptation of Mega Man for some time; the developer confirmed that a movie was being made in 2018 , which was initially being handled by 20th Century Fox (now 20th Century Studios).
Things were quiet for the next few years until 2020, when Henry Joost and Ariel Schulman, who were set to write and direct this movie, confirmed that it was still very much in production .

“We are super excited about it. I think we’re going to have some big news about it soon. I can’t say all that much right now, but it’s a project very near and dear to our hearts and we’re psyched,” Joost said at the time.

In 2021, Netflix announced that it was making a live action film based on Capcom’s legacy 2D platformer, which appeared to be unrelated to 20th Century’s Mega Man project. For now, it’s unclear if this newest listing is involved with either of those productions, and the slim information that's been provided is making fans' imaginations run wild.

Of course, most players are keen for a Mega Man Legends remake, or at least another title in that particular series. The first Mega Man Legends game was released all the way back in 1998; a sequel came out in 2000, and a spin-off title, The Misadventures of Tron Bonne , launched in 1999. With Dual Override coming in 2027, and Capcom expressing an interest in reviving its older IP , it’s certainly possible that there’s already another Mega Man title in the works — and remakes of legacy games are proving to be a real hit right now, after all.

For now, Mega Man fans can check out our interview with Dual Override’s Director Shinya Ikuta, Producer Hiroyuki Minamitani, Art Director Yuji Ishihara, and Art Director Shinsuke Komaki, where we asked them all about the game and what players can expect when it finally releases.

news.title: 这位独立开发者正在打造“有史以来最暴力、舒适的农场游戏”，而伐木业看起来从未如此酷
news.summary: New type of wizard just dropped.

content.v: When I say the words "cozy farming game," it probably conjures a certain set of images: topdown sprites, daily crop-related chores, a cast of townsfolk primed and ready to be the focus of hyperfixation. What it probably doesn't conjure is the image of a burly lumberjack-wizard launching an anime-ass energy wave from his magic logging axe that splits a line of trees lengthwise so that their falling halves can instantly level the surrounding forest.

But now, I know that it should—and it's thanks to Spellogger , a first-person lumbermancy RPG being developed by solo dev Basti to serve as "the most violent cozy farming game ever made." And as you'll see in the video embedded below, Basti is making excellent progress towards that goal.
I'm making the most violent cozy farming game ever made https://t.co/fHAnrFUbLC November 10, 2026

Like your various Stardew-likes, Spellogger starts with the player arriving at their newly-acquired farmstead. Unlike your various Stardew-likes, however, you're not a farmer: You're a lumberjacking wizard in a magical forest that grows infinite trees overnight, and your goal is to deploy your escalating arcane mastery to harvest as much lumber as possible through increasingly-absurd tree-felling spellcraft.

There are no enemies. There is no livestock. There is only a constantly-renewed forest of trees that shoot off damage numbers when you hit them and announce OVERKILL if you happen to hit them very hard.

I don't know why this is the specific game the Swedish solo dev decided to make, but I do know that I admire the commitment to the bit. Basti's X feed is a gleeful showcase for whatever wizard nonsense was most recently implemented as a Spellogger feature, from carving through saplings by throwing an enchanted axe like a boomerang, to detonating trees with bursts of chain lightning , and even summoning a meteor from orbit to give entire groves the dinosaur treatment.
In my lumberjack game you can summon a meteor to take down trees, cause why not. https://t.co/2Uv4pXNXoB October 20, 2026
I want to stress once again that this is a magic forest with infinite trees. So, you know. It's fine. In a fantasy setting, anything can be environmentally sustainable.

Spellogger doesn't have a release date, but it's due to launch on Steam sometime in 2027. It does , however, have a demo available—though you'll only get to progress through the first 10 levels of lumbermancy. The meteors will have to wait.

content.v: 《铁拳》制作人原田胜弘批评Xbox Series S增加了主机游戏的适配负担，CDPR副游戏总监Paweł Sasko则认为，针对低规格设备进行的优化也能惠及其他平台。两人在首尔举行的一场开发者对谈中，对同一硬件限制给出了不同看法。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794436587_671989_jpg_r.jpg
这场对谈由前Sony独立游戏负责人吉田修平主持。谈及主机相较PC的优缺点时，原田胜弘表示，Series S内存较少，性能又以一种尴尬的幅度低于Series X。开发者完成高规格版本后，还要为同一家族中的较弱设备投入额外工作。
原田胜弘称，美国等市场拥有大量Series S用户，开发团队不能简单减少投入；但如果画质或同屏角色数量缩水，玩家的不满往往又会指向开发者。
Paweł Sasko承认，Series S持续给开发团队带来挑战，也迫使团队更彻底地优化代码。不过，他认为为低规格平台取得的优化突破可以反哺PS5、高端PC、Steam Deck和ROG Ally。《赛博朋克2077》2.5版就采用了团队为Switch 2版本准备一年多所得的部分成果。
Sasko还表示，Series S较低的价格能够扩大受众，让更多人接触游戏。在他看来，这款设备带来适配成本的同时，也可能推动跨平台优化并扩大市场覆盖。

该计划公布的时间临近《GTA6》发售，但并非专门为这款游戏设置。相关讨论同时涉及新作上市对职场出勤和生产效率的影响，有专家估计，该作上市可能在美国造成10亿美元的生产力损失；这一数字属于专家估算，并非罗技对计划效果的测算。

《GTA6》不支持Xbox云游戏，但支持Xbox远程游玩，玩家可以从Xbox或PlayStation主机串流至电脑或移动设备。罗技此次计划的核心，则是把游戏文化转化为一项可由员工灵活使用的福利。

同期影视排期较为密集。《指环王：力量之戒》第三季将从11月11日起播出，约翰尼·德普回归银幕的新片《Ebenezer》定于11月13日上映。《饥饿游戏：收割日出》将在游戏发售次日上映，《黄蜂》第四季和《波西·杰克逊与奥林匹亚众神》第三季也将在当天上线，《银翼杀手2099》则于五天后推出。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794433415_706693_jpg_r.jpg
普华永道全球媒体、娱乐、游戏及体育业务负责人Bart Spiegel表示，《GTA6》的发行不仅会成为游戏行业的节点，整个媒体娱乐行业也需要面对用户转向游戏的情况。他认为，流媒体与客厅电视上的主机游戏直接争夺时间，因此可能受到更明显的影响；直播体育具有即时性，受到的冲击相对较小。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794433416_297831_jpg_r.jpg
The Game Awards制作人Geoff Keighley预测，该作可能成为娱乐行业规模最大的发行事件，其对影院、流媒体和用户时间的影响，比单纯收入更值得关注。相关预测还包括首年销量4500万份、收入32亿美元，以及29%的美国玩家有意购买；这些数字目前均为预测，并非已经实现的业绩。

content.v: 《 上古卷轴6 ：哨兵》的正式标题引出一种地图范围推测。ComicBook作者认为，新作可探索区域或许将聚焦哨兵城邦，而非覆盖红卫人故乡落锤省全境；不过，Bethesda尚未正式说明游戏的地图边界、面积和具体舞台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794433353_601506_jpg_r.jpg
这一推测主要来自预告中被沙掩埋的上古卷轴、作品标题和结尾引语。作者认为，这些内容都指向落锤省，而“哨兵”既可以指当地的重要城市，也可以指该城市所属的同名政治区域。
近几部系列主线作品采用高岩、晨风或天际等较大文化区域命名，新作却没有直接使用“落锤”。作者据此推测，游戏舞台可能仅限于哨兵城邦。另一种可能是，Bethesda只是出于主题表达选择这一名称，“哨兵”包含的守卫之意也可能与梭默入侵后的故事背景有关。
作者还提出，叙事所覆盖的地理范围缩小，并不意味着实际可玩地图一定更小。如果团队用接近《上古卷轴5：天际》的地图面积描绘一个更小的政治区域，或可更细致地呈现当地环境、文化和故事，同时让泰姆瑞尔在世界观尺度上显得更加广阔。目前，这些判断仍是基于标题、系列命名传统和既有设定的评论性推演。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 一批在微软2026年7月裁员中离开id Software的开发者成立了新工作室Hidden Horses。工作室现有19名成员，采用员工共有模式，首款作品《危险报酬》已经通过Kickstarter公开。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794433108_709282_jpg_r.jpg
截至2026年7月，已确认离开id Software的员工达到136人。工作室管理层表示，这一数字约占原团队的一半。裁员发生在《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》“启示录”DLC推出前后，多名受影响员工在Hidden Horses的成立纪录片中回忆了当天的冲击。
联合创始人John-Michael Quinlan表示，在DLC发布前失去大量人才，让他感觉像是一次“攻击”。其他成员还谈到失去长期共事的朋友、家庭经济压力，以及无法像往常一样享受作品发售日。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794433110_407604_jpg_r.jpg
《危险报酬》是一款单人第一人称射击游戏，以致命游戏节目为背景，强调高速动作和玩法设计。团队表示，离开大型公司后，成员拥有了更高的创作自由，可以共同讨论想法并决定推进方向。制作人员还计划打造统一且风格鲜明的视觉效果，并充分优化运行表现。目前游戏尚未公布确定的发售日期与目标平台，众筹结果也未披露。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《 上古卷轴5：天际 》于2011年11月11日发售，如今迎来15周年。一篇周年回顾认为，自由探索和玩家Mod仍在支撑这款 开放世界 角色扮演游戏的长期生命力；发稿时，其Steam同时在线玩家约为4万人。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794433066_814379_jpg_r.jpg
作者认为，游戏在角色扮演层面存在较明显的缺陷，但独特氛围、鲜明的时间与地域感，以及难以预料的动态事件，依然构成了难被其他作品取代的体验。
自由形式也是作者重点提到的特点。玩家在旅途中很容易偏离原定目标，被支线任务、地点或偶发事件吸引，因此即使重新开档，也可能形成与此前不同的个人冒险。
玩家Mod社区同样延长了游戏的生命。模组制作者十余年来持续维护和扩展作品，目前仍有人推进规模庞大的项目。《上古卷轴6》的漫长等待，也在一定程度上强化了《上古卷轴5：天际》的地位。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 《猩红沙漠》荣获 2026 年金摇杆奖“年度 PC 游戏”
news.summary: Resident Evil Requiem and Meccha Chameleon were the night's other big winners.

content.v: There was some fun conversation here at PC Gamer recently about the anachronistic name of The Golden Joystick Awards. Who even uses a joystick anymore? Flight sim diehards, fighting game enthusiasts, and not many others. So why is it called that? Joysticks , really?

Simply put, the name reflects the age of the awards, which debuted in 1983, making it the longest-running publicly-voted videogame awards show of all time, according to Wikipedia. Back in those days, joysticks were it, and trust me, they weren't the sweet pieces of hardware we have access to now. But we loved 'em! And we used them to play games like the Golden Joysticks' first-ever game of the year, Jetpac. It was a banger!

Here we are, 43 years later, and much has changed: From a tiny ceremony handing out five trophies, the Golden Joysticks have grown to become one of the biggest videogame awards events of the year, watched by millions of people around the world on just about every streaming platform you can name. Yet that name, the Golden Joystick Awards , remains. Frankly, I'm glad about that. A little bit of reliability in this world is good for everyone.

Which leads me to the point: The 44 th annual Golden Joystick Awards has now concluded, and the top gong , as my UK compatriots like to say for some reason—the Ultimate Game of the Year award, for the rest of us—has gone to Resident Evil Requiem , Capcom's latest tale of zombie-fueled bad news.

Can't really argue with that call: PC Gamer's Elie Gould gave Resident Evil Requiem a whopping 92% score in their review , saying it "feels like you're playing a highlight reel of the best moments in the series." Requiem claimed three other wins on the night: Console Game of the Year, Best Game Trailer, and Best Lead Performer for Angela Sant'Albano's turn as Grace Ashcroft.

Crimson Desert won for PC Game of the Year, which surprises me a bit given that it's also on consoles and pretty much the same experience. We liked that one too: Not quite as enthusiastically, but it still earned an enviable 80% review score . "Vast and obtuse in a way that is going to frustrate some and exhilarate others," as reviewer Mollie Taylor put it: "A fascinating journey, even when the destination isn't all that."

Multiplayer hide-and-seek game Meccha Chameleon was the night's other big winner, taking home four awards for Best Multiplayer Game, Best Indie Game (self-published), the Steamers' Choice Award, and Developer's Choice Award. Dispatch won twice, for Best Storytelling and Best Soundtrack, and The Witcher also sort of claimed two wins as well: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered took the trophy for Best Remake/Remaster, while The Witcher 4 won for Most Wanted Game.
So there you have it, 44 years down and hopefully many more to come—all of them bearing that glorious golden name. Here's your full list of 2026 Golden Joystick Awards winners:

同类候选还包括《空之轨迹 the 2nd》《星际火狐》《合金装备：大师合集 Vol.2》《哥特王朝1：重制版》和《刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置 》。
《巫师3：狂猎》与金摇杆奖的联系始于发售前。该作在2013年和2014年两次获得最受期待游戏，2015年正式推出后又获得最佳叙事、最佳视觉设计、最佳游戏时刻和终极年度游戏，其中最佳游戏时刻来自“血腥男爵”任务。
次年，资料片《巫师3：狂猎—血与酒》获得最佳叙事和最佳视觉设计，杰洛特配音演员Doug Cockle获得最佳游戏表演。按文中统计，《巫师3：狂猎》直接取得的金摇杆奖现已达到10个；若按照吉尼斯世界纪录采用的口径，将CDPR在2015年和2016年获得的年度工作室奖计入，总数则为12个。
这一成绩继续领先《博德之门3》和《光与影：33号远征队》，后两款作品均曾在单届获得七项相关荣誉。

content.v: 《GTA6》因发售时间未达到本届评选要求，无法进入2026年金摇杆奖主要奖项。其缺席并非遭到刻意排除，而是上市日期晚于规定的资格窗口。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794431550_584182_jpg_r.jpg
金摇杆奖主要类别要求参评游戏在2025年11月1日至2026年9月25日之间发售，最高奖“终极年度游戏”的截止日期则延长至10月25日。由评审投票决定的奖项范围更宽，截至11月11日颁奖礼举行当天推出的作品仍可参加。
《GTA6》定于颁奖礼结束后的下一周上市，未能赶上主要年度奖项的截止时间。按照规则，该作可以参与“最受期待游戏”评选，但这并不意味着它能进入本届主要年度奖项。
游戏大奖将于12月10日举行，届时《GTA6》已经上市数周。该活动采用评审投票，获得评测资格的评委可能在典礼前接触作品。DICE、GDC和英国电影学院游戏奖等活动将在2027年初举办，该作届时可能成为竞争者；按照金摇杆奖的评选周期，它也将在2027届获得参评资格。

content.v: CDPR确认，《 巫师3：狂猎 》新DLC“ 旧时曲” 将使用Respeecher技术调整杰洛特的波兰语配音。演员Jacek Rozenek仍会亲自录制新台词，相关技术不会取代其表演，而是让新录音更接近他在2019年中风前留下的声线，使新旧对白衔接得更加一致。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794431316_492936_jpg_r.jpg
Rozenek表示，这项工作的目标是让声音尽量接近自己12年前的状态，他对游戏创作者及其处理方式抱有很高信任。整个流程已获得演员知情同意，制作团队还设置了人工审核环节，对每段对白逐一检查。
CDPR本地化制作人Mikołaj Szwed承认，人工智能是配音社群高度关注的问题。他认为，在演员知情同意、继续参与表演且结果接受人工审查的情况下，这种技术运用属于较为合乎伦理的方式。
此次调整仅涉及波兰语演出。Doug Cockle负责的英语版杰洛特对白不会采用相同处理。《巫师3：狂猎》新DLC“旧时曲”将于2027年推出。

content.v: 第39届中国电影金鸡奖颁奖典礼11月10日晚在厦门举行，68岁的梁家辉凭悬疑电影《捕风追影》获得最佳男主角。这是他从影四十多年来首次获得金鸡奖提名，也是首次提名便成功获奖。他由此被称为继梁朝伟之后，第二位集齐香港电影金像奖、金马奖和中国电影金鸡奖最佳男主角荣誉的香港演员。

news.title: 新的 GTA 6 惊喜游戏似乎又一病毒式营销噱头发布
news.summary: Rockstar Games appears to have released new footage from GTA 6, which also recreates the studio's real-life vi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/gta-6-jason-and-lucia-drive-by-1793234705694.jpg
Rockstar Games appears to have released new footage from GTA 6 , which also recreates the studio's real-life viral marketing in-game.

A new Instagram post from the account "Only in Dade" began to raise eyebrows earlier today, as it appeared to contain legitimate footage of GTA 6. The footage shows someone driving down Ocean Drive, recording a bunch of flashy cars lined up while people wander past. A second person on the sidewalk recorded the exact same video from a different perspective. Some fans think that the two people recording are Jason and Lucia, respectively, though the footage isn't clear enough to be able to confidently make that determination.

Many were wondering if this was AI footage or a render until Rockstar Games reposted it on its Instagram story and liked the video, indicating this is likely real in-game footage. The studio is very careful and calculated with what it chooses to post and interact with, so it isn't going around liking random AI-generated clips of its upcoming game.

However, what's even more interesting is that this footage directly recreates a real-life video from last month. Rockstar teamed up with West Coast Customs to bring cars from GTA 6 to real life and spent October parading them around the city of Miami. As a result, there were tons of videos and social media posts about these vehicles, and one has now seemingly been recreated in GTA 6. You can see the same people, including a person on a motorized scooter and a man taking pictures in front of one of the cars, all replicated in the GTA 6 footage above.

It's clear that Rockstar's marketing strategy has gotten extremely creative, and it's a bit of a flex to produce something that has many wondering if the visuals are too good to be true. Rockstar also pulled off a similar stunt a couple of weeks ago when it debuted a tiny bit of new gameplay during an episode of South Park . The footage wasn't advertised ahead of time, so people also thought that it might be AI-generated gameplay until Rockstar's name was discovered in the credits.

The hype for GTA 6 is currently at its peak, releasing in just one week. The launch represents the end of a 13-year journey for many fans, as Rockstar hasn't made a new GTA game since 2013. There was, of course, Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018, which certainly helped tide some fans over... but that was still nearly a decade ago at this point.

Pre-loading has officially begun so fans can prepare for their trip to Vice City next week. Rockstar has also released new trailers , screenshots , and other marketing beats, which have created a flury of speculation over what may or may not be in the game . Thankfully, we won't have to wait much longer to find out.

content.v: 消息称，索尼已经终止Haven Studios开发的服务型PvP射击游戏《公平游戏》。该作公开已有三年，开发据称持续约三至四年，但近期大规模内部测试的结果未达到PlayStation管理层预期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794430079_108046_jpg_r.jpg
《公平游戏》的核心玩法在开发期间经过数次调整，项目也接受了多轮内部测试。近期一次测试有数千名玩家参加，相关内部备忘录显示，玩家反馈和留存结果表现不一，低于公司设定的目标。
备忘录同时肯定了团队的运营执行、长期运营准备及社区互动能力。管理层还提到当前PvP射击游戏市场环境艰难，最终决定停止开发，并未将原因归结为单次测试失利。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794430081_833323_jpg_r.jpg
这一决定也让索尼推动服务型游戏的计划再度遭遇挫折。相关消息列举了《星鸣特攻》和《毁灭全明星》等项目的结果，并认为《绝地潜兵2》是目前少数取得突出表现的成果。
截至消息发布时，Haven Studios尚未出现裁员。工作室接下来将协助其他开发团队，同时探索“新的创意机会”。索尼目前尚未就终止《公平游戏》开发发布独立公开公告。

news.title: 狸猫：Pon 的夏季回顾
news.summary: While some parts of Tanuki: Pon's Summer don't live up to what makes it special, it still captures the vibe of

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/11/tanuki-pons-summer-blogroll-02-1794428582840.jpg

Frost hasn't yet replaced New England's morning dew, but cold air is starting to settle in. Days feel short, and the sun sets before I've signed off from work for the day. I complain all summer about the heat, then want it back just as it starts to fade: Long, meandering days that are full of potential. It feels fitting – and maybe a bit ironic – that as soon as my mind (and maybe yours) starts wandering back to summer, Kyoto-based studio Denkiworks released its homage to summer in rural Japan with Tanuki: Pon's Summer. It's a game that feels just as warm as the summer depicted, and a nice reprieve from the looming cold.

Tanuki: Pon's Summer is set in an idyllic Japanese countryside that's centered around an aging shrine. Pon, the tanuki tasked with tending to it, let the shrine's grounds crumble while he ate chips and played video games. Tanuki gods bully Pon into getting his act together and fixing the shrine before a big festival. But that'll cost money, and money comes from a job. Pon's skills are limited, but he does have a BMX bike. To the post office it is! You play through a month of Pon's summer, delivering the island's mail to earn money to fix the shrine, and days are all marked on a calendar. Along the way, it so perfectly captures the lazy opportunity of summer in its moment-to-moment about a relaxed town.

The island is not big, but it's quite dense with several distinct, lively parts of town and Pon must figure out how to get around efficiently on his bike. (You can walk; Pon can't jump on foot, but can on his bike, so walking for even short distances is not effective.) Conveniently, the island is bike-friendly, especially BMX bike-friendly with the makings of a skatepark. So, delivering mail is not just a thing you do – it's the draw.

Each day, Pon picks up the mail from the post office, stacking them in a basket through a Tetris-like minigame that feels like a welcome ritual each in-game day. Then, he heads out. Tanuki: Pon's Summer is open-world in the sense that you can make deliveries in any order, but the storyline is linear. Some of the packages are simple dropoffs, but others have an activity or a storyline attached to them and to the people of the island. Among them are rival sushi and yakitori chefs, a creatively-stifled photographer, and a tough guy with a soft spot. All of these characters are delightfully weird, and their stories follow suit.

Those rival chefs, for instance, have some longstanding beef between each other, and aren't initially very nice to Pon, either. They know him as a lazy tanuki who let the shrine crumble, and throughout Pon's month as a mailman, their attitudes toward each other (and Pon!) soften. Pon's adventure, too, helps reunite an estranged father and daughter, who are both artisan makers. Tanuki: Pon's Summer may have Pon in the name, but it's hardly Pon's story that's being told. It's a charming one that's more focused on the relationships between people on the island and the community they make together.

Crucially, each of these island residents needs help with something, which is where Tanuki: Pon's Summer's minigames come in. And there are a lot, like skewering meat and veggies to make yakitori, stacking pieces of sushi to order, sanding logs, serving shaved ice and foamy beer, checking out customers at the convenience store, playing the drums for a local musician, hitting home runs at the local baseball field. Minigames like these (and a bunch others) mimic that sort of delight of childhood summers in which anything seemed possible. They're the sorts of small adventures that break up drifting days in the summer heat.

But not all of these minigames are as joyous, though. Several of them feel like a monotonous drag where Pon sands down logs at a snail's pace or another that forces Pon to cut down far too many bamboo stalks. Sure, we had to do chores on a summer break, but I resented some of the minigames for taking me away from the excitement of riding Pon's bike around town and many of the other things I'd have rather been doing.

You could put all sorts of descriptors on it, whether that's a mail delivery simulator, a BMX freestyle game, or a cooking game. And oftentimes, this approach brought a lot of whimsy and a steady variety from moment to moment. But there were a bit too many where I wanted Tanuki: Pon's Summer to let me get back to the thing I liked most about the game: Riding around on Pon's bike.

The core of Tanuki: Pon's Summer is getting from place to place on his bike while making an extreme sport out of it. He bunny hops over small cliffs, grinds down handrails, and pulls off tricks over gaps and soars over sunny rooftops. Tricks are simple enough to pull off by directional stick movements and button inputs while in air, but stringing them together for combos is a bit more tricky. Optional challenges dotted around the island offer a chance to test your skill, but otherwise the game doesn't ask Pon to prove himself, aside from the occasional request where a resident asks Pon to do some tricks, under a time limit, to reach a certain number of points. (All tricks amass points, which typically don't mean anything. It pops up on screen even if you're doing a barspin into a wheelie on your way to just deliver a model kit.) It doesn't necessarily need to ask, because the BMX freestyle itself is a blast. On deliveries, I longed for long stretches of road to see how far I could make Pon wheelie. I used helpfully placed ramps to look for new routes and bounced from roof top to roof top just to show off.

The worst of Tanuki: Pon's Summer's minigames either lingered for too long or felt dull compared to the fun of his bike. Although they are relatively short, those select minigames (emphasis on mini) dragged in a way that broke up the momentum I'd have from riding around town and doing tricks on my way to the next delivery. Most of them don't repeat – Pon is asked once, for instance, to balance and roll boulders through a tricky maze or to pour the perfect beers from a bar's tap. Once Pon's done, he's done. He's moved on to the next task, and whoever asked for his help won't ask him to do that particular chore again, but they may ask for some other sort of help.

The last piece of Tanuki: Pon's Summer to talk about is the shrine decor, which is entirely optional. People who enjoyed decorating their Animal Crossing: New Horizons islands may be drawn to this in particular. Slowly, more of the shrine opens up big, empty swaths of land you can decorate – up to you whether or not it's worthwhile. Pon collects decor and furniture from the quests he's set upon by islanders, but he can also purchase stuff from the kitsune lingering around. His overarching goal is about getting the shrine together for the big festival, but the decorating simulator felt extraneous for me. There's no real parameters here to guide the direction or to make the feature feel consequential in any way – it's just something to do. Again, it felt like a slower piece of the game that took me away from the parts I liked best.

news.title: 《地狱铸造》将于27年1月18日开启Steam抢先体验
news.summary: 由 MoonPyre Studio 开发、RPG 发行商 Grindstone（代表作：《巨人杀手：暗黑之潮 》）发行的撤离式弹幕地狱游戏《地狱铸造》（Hellforged），将于2027年1月18日在 Steam 开启

content.v: 由 MoonPyre Studio 开发、RPG 发行商 Grindstone（代表作：《巨人杀手：暗黑之潮 》）发行的撤离式弹幕地狱游戏《地狱铸造》（Hellforged），将于2027年1月18日在 Steam 开启抢先体验。
https://image.gcores.com/ca8f35b728454bca946296d228655681-1920-1080.jpg
这一发售日期于今晚的金摇杆奖（Golden Joystick Awards）颁奖典礼上正式公布，同时发布的还有一支全新预告片，展示了自上一次 Demo 以来游戏所发生的变化。
《地狱铸造》是一款以战利品收集为核心的撤离式弹幕地狱游戏。每次冒险，玩家都会深入恶魔横行的废墟，与成群的敌人展开战斗，并收集能够改变玩法的装备及其词条。探索得越深入，获得的战利品就越丰厚，但与此同时，失去一切的风险也越高。
https://image.gcores.com/9eb668417bb92282e1733ef486b6694a-1920-1080.jpg
及时撤离，就能保留所有收获；如果在战斗中倒下，辛苦获得的一切都将付诸东流。在每次冒险之间，玩家可以培养自己的英雄，并不断推进进程，最终彻底摧毁黑焰（Blackpyre）。
根据 GameDiscoverCo 的数据，游戏于今年8月推出的首个公开 Demo，在未发售 Steam 游戏 Demo 的同时在线玩家数量排名中位列第7。截至目前，游戏在 Steam 上的愿望单数量已突破15万。
https://image.gcores.com/daf49c2814a07e1e14f09d1f9cc1abc3-1920-1080.jpg
Demo 玩家还通过 Discord 和 Steam 提交了大量反馈，并促成了一系列体验优化内容，这些改进都将随抢先体验版本一同推出。
MoonPyre Studio 创始人 Lukas Tomondy 表示：
“这次 Demo 教会我们的东西，比数月的内部测试还要多。玩家们在短短几天内就发现了游戏中所有不够完善的地方，并通过 Discord 向我们反馈，其中很多反馈都非常详细。抢先体验版本中的许多改进都直接来自这些交流，而这也是我们希望持续开发《地狱铸造》的方式——在正式版发布之前，不断倾听玩家的声音，与玩家共同完善游戏。”
抢先体验版本有哪些新内容？
抢先体验版本将推出四名英雄，每名英雄都拥有鲜明的职业特色：
索伦：圣骑士
莫滕齐亚：黑暗精灵法师
伊拉里昂：阿洛克猎人，玩家此前已可在 Steam 新品节期间体验该角色
全新近战英雄：兽人屠戮者
此外，每名英雄现在都拥有各自独特的技能槽类别组合，使不同英雄之间的玩法差异更加鲜明。
玩家将在三张地图中展开冒险：
地下陵墓：Demo 中已有的地图。
诅咒荒原：全新地图，包含三种不同变体。
棘木谷：全新地图，包含两至三种不同变体。
更深入的战利品系统
战利品系统将得到进一步扩展。
完成与独特装备相关的预兆后，玩家即可获得对应的独特装备。
带有镶嵌孔的装备可以镶嵌宝石，以获得额外属性加成；宝珠可以重新随机生成装备词缀数值；卷轴则可以在军械库中提升技能等级。
全新难度与成长系统
全新的「地狱铸造」难度将加入更多折磨挑战，为希望体验更高难度冒险的玩家带来全新挑战。
成就系统也将迎来升级。现在，完成成就可以获得点数，用于解锁称号、外观皮肤和展示栏位。玩家还可以自行选择哪些成就会显示在排行榜个人记录旁。
此外，玩家可以在游戏世界中寻找书籍，逐步填充档案馆图书馆。这些书籍不仅会讲述完整的故事，还能为玩家提供额外经验值奖励。
抢先体验只是游戏旅程的起点，而不是终点。在迈向正式版的过程中，开发团队还将持续推出全新内容与更新。

news.title: 微软大规模裁员后，前 id Software 开发人员组建了自己的员工拥有的射击工作室
news.summary: Hidden Horses, co-founded by "approximately 20" former id devs, is planning a Kickstarter campaign to help fun

content.v: As part of its July 2026 wave of Xbox job cuts, Microsoft laid off a reported 136 developers from id Software, a studio whose name is synonymous with expertise in shooter design and engineering. Today, "approximately 20" of those former id developers announced the formation of Hidden Horses, an employee-owned game studio boasting "over 250 collective years" of game dev experience between its co-founders.

"This team has spent years building games together, and we realized that what made that experience special wasn't just the projects we worked on; it was the people we worked with," Hidden Horses engine programmer and co-founder Dustin Land said in a press release . "Hidden Horses is an opportunity to keep that team together, build something of our own, and create the kind of old school shooters that we think people want more of."

On its website , the studio says it was formed as a democratically governed, developer-owned company so it can prioritize "long-term health over short-term growth, longevity over quarterly returns, and innovative gameplay over shady monetization"—for the sake of its games, and the studio staff creating them.

"We're creating a studio where the developers share in its success and have a commitment to it beyond just another job," said co-founder and executive producer Andrew Willis, "I think that when people have a stake in something’s success, they are more committed to it.”

The studio is planning to launch a Kickstarter campaign to support the development of its first planned game: a singleplayer arena shooter called Danger Pay, in which players will participate in a televised ultraviolent game show inspired by works like The Running Man (the 1987 movie, not the 2025 one) and 1990's Smash TV—a game that, I've just now learned, got a novella adaptation in 1992 . So. Now I get to have that knowledge bouncing around.

"We've had the privilege of spending our careers making games for incredible communities of players," said Johnmichael Quinlin, studio co-founder and tools programmer. "Now we have the chance to build something new together, and we're excited to invite those players along for the journey from the very beginning."
If you want to stay posted on what Hidden Horses is up to, you can follow the studio on its Bluesky account .

news.title: GTA 6 粉丝认为最新预告片中隐藏了上一款游戏中深受喜爱的传统角色
news.summary: The most recent GTA 6 trailer has many people wondering if an iconic character from a previous game in the fra

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/05/lucia-caminos-14-1793891731331.jpg
The most recent GTA 6 trailer has many people wondering if an iconic character from a previous game in the franchise is making a return.

In the latest GTA 6 trailer , released yesterday to announce pre-loads , a character in a blue tank top and bulky black glasses is seen saying, "Oh, it is so on now." This is seemingly the first time we've seen this mystery character in GTA 6, and there may be a reason for that. Some fans believe this is an older and slightly chubbier Tony Prince (AKA Gay Tony). The character made his debut in GTA 4 and appeared in both DLCs, but was the focus of The Ballad of Gay Tony expansion. In that story, players filled the shoes of Luis, Tony's right-hand man. Tony Prince was a prominent nightclub owner in Liberty City, but he has since bounced around.

Why does this guy actually kinda look and sound like Tony? I’m losing my mind, similar glasses, beard and very similar voice. There’s no way he let himself go and moved to the keys right? https://t.co/NH1Ltr7I93

Tony moved to Los Santos years later and returned in a GTA Online update, giving missions to the player as part of the game's nightclub operations. Now, some fans believe he may have moved to Vice City/Leonida, though he may have fallen on hard times. He looks more out of shape, he's missing his high-end sense of style, minus the glasses, and he doesn't appear to be living it up in a highrise apartment or anything like that.

The character has the same style of beard, glasses, and has a similar voice to Tony, but it's hard to say if it really is him. It could be someone who somewhat resembles him, but the speculation is driving some fans mad. GTA 6 will lean pretty heavily on Vice City's nightlife, with clubbing being prominently featured in the trailers released by Rockstar (including the pre-load ad). One of the in-game clubs, known as Jack of Hearts, is also expected to be a haven for celebrities and real-life musicans. Travis Scott namedropped it in his song, RHYNO, which will be featured in the game, and a screenshot revealed Kodak Black will hang out there as an NPC .

Naturally, it would make tons of sense for GTA's nightclub king to be part of the festivities in Vice City. We'll ultimately just have to wait and see, but thankfully, we are only days away from finding out. We have just a week left until GTA 6 launches, and it looks like it's going to make a big splash. The game is currently the most pre-ordered game in the history of the Xbox and PlayStation digital stores , suggesting all kinds of sales records will be broken next weekend.

news.title: Exterminauts 看起来像另一部《地狱潜伏者 2》，但真正应该引起注意的是深岩银河的病态者
news.summary: The Dead By Daylight studio takes on a co-op shooter.

content.v: It's best to go into game demos with a clear mind, but that was never in the cards for Exterminauts , the new co-op game from Dead by Daylight studio Behavior Interactive. Everything about Exterminauts, externally, screams Helldivers 2, from its working class soldiers and anonymized outfits to its hostile wildlife and colorfully pulpy planets.

Exterminauts' developers, who are a distinct team from the one making Dead By Daylight, see the comparisons coming and don't shy away from them, but they also point out that their game was in development for years before Arrowhead's hit shooter came out in 2024.

They also draw a distinction in tone: Exterminauts does not cast you as a dedicated servant of intergalactic democracy, but as militarized, blue-collar pest control cleansing the planet of Tian so that corporate interests can better sap the land of its resources. In that way and more, Exterminauts has more in common with Deep Rock Galactic or Mycopunk .

That's a realization that helped me acclimate to Exterminauts after a few hours with an alpha build—it's got Deep Rock-like milestones, class roles, and mission types. Loadouts begin with a choice of a soft class (called sponsors) that grants passive bonuses and a unique power weapon. There's one that comes with a medic tool and a damage-focused lightning gun that I gravitated toward. You can also bring along gadgets like ammo boxes, med packs, and automated turrets that could singlehandedly flatten a horde (Behaviour admitted these were overpowered at the moment).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aJ9bgpnt4i6kdXfhLN5eZQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Er3WYtz9JEZXJ8bdXofkbQ-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eMfgmiJtAjxYhkE2kyb5QQ-1920-80.jpg
Work-life balance

It's relevant to note that my developer-led demo stayed on the lower difficulties, but even with that in mind, Exterminauts struck me as more casual than games like it. Guns are very easy to control with a mouse, friendly fire is either barely there or nonexistent, ammo was readily available through pickups at every point of interest, and there's a generous respawn mechanic that lets you summon teammates back into the action.

The maps I played were straightforward canyons littered with corporate mining facilities. Objectives were clearly marked on the map from the start, as are side tasks. There's clear Helldivers inspiration in the jobs themselves—there's a lot of solving micro puzzles on computer screens to get a facility back online—but I never really felt rushed to complete them because the fauna barely put up a fight.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/yVPQTJec6BvqCrm9VcLLQP-1920-80.jpg

I'd like to see what Exterminauts is like when it's challenging, because its creative creatures have a lot more bark than they do bite. No bugs or robot hordes here—Behaviour is leaning into freaky plant monsters and flying squids. I especially enjoyed the giant carnivorous flytraps that crawl on six feet and the flying, spiky tulips that slow down enemies until they're dealt with.

Cranking up the difficulty might also bring the depth of its classes into focus—each sponsor (class) can be modified through firmware unlocked through play. These looked like small bonuses, like extra freeze damage or HP gained on kill, that can be stacked to make a bigger impact.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/u3AMGiYc2vgWmnuCnhTRJQ-1920-80.jpg

Behaviour is planning large and frequent updates for Exterminauts, including 12-week seasons and a constant drip feed of sponsorship packages that introduce new weapons, gadgets, cosmetics, and firmware modifiers. The idea is to make these relatively easy to unlock through normal play, but you'll be able to buy them early for real money, too.

A general lack of energy led to my demo feeling rudimentary and sometimes boring—I was craving a sense of risk or struggle that gives co-op shooters moment-to-moment stakes, but never got it. These strike me as problems that can be solved, and Exterminauts does have good bones, so I'll be interested to try it again when it's more complete.

news.title: 以克罗姆之名！ 《柯南: 黑色金字塔》于金摇杆奖正式公布
news.summary: 今日，在金摇杆（Golden Joystick Awards）颁奖典礼期间，RPG 发行商 Grindstone 正式公布了由资深游戏开发工作室 Games Farm 打造的《柯南: 黑色金字塔》。 本作是一款以罗伯特·

content.v: 今日，在金摇杆（Golden Joystick Awards）颁奖典礼期间，RPG 发行商 Grindstone 正式公布了由资深游戏开发工作室 Games Farm 打造的《柯南: 黑色金字塔》。
https://image.gcores.com/a698982e8025c345d8b4ba878bbf6eca-1920-1080.jpg
本作是一款以罗伯特·欧文 ·霍华德共享宇宙为背景、获得官方授权的动作类 Roguelite RPG，预计于2027年通过 Steam 登陆 PC 平台。目前，游戏的 Steam 商店页面已正式上线。
某种神秘力量正将传奇英雄从各自所处的时代召唤而来。柯南、所罗门·凯恩、黑暗艾格尼丝以及其他英雄在黑色金字塔中苏醒。这是一座无视时空法则、并会随着每次深入而不断变化的迷宫。每一次冒险，都将让他们距离核心谜团更近一步：究竟是谁将他们召唤至此？
https://image.gcores.com/447f7dd2bcf345f11c7621adef019dff-1920-1080.jpg
玩家可以操控五名不同的角色，灵活结合近战、剑术、枪械与魔法展开战斗。每一场战斗都会逐步积累终结技的力量，而何时释放这股毁灭性的力量，则由玩家自行决定。
通过战士记忆、远古神器与战斗精通系统，玩家可以打造独特的角色流派。此外，玩家还可以在冒险途中收集骰子，并选择立即使用它们来获取更好的战利品，或将其留到风险更高的关键时刻。
https://image.gcores.com/424c94b5af26ff1431bf0a296f3c9a7b-1920-1080.jpg
你可以独自踏上冒险，也可以邀请一位好友，通过双人在线合作模式共同探索黑色金字塔。
游戏核心特色
动作类 Roguelite RPG：在剑与魔法的世界中直面宇宙恐怖。
高保真硬核视觉表现：采用更接近动作 RPG 的画面风格，区别于传统 Roguelite 游戏。
5名可操控英雄：角色均来自罗伯特·欧文·霍华德的文学世界，包括柯南、所罗门·凯恩与黑暗艾格尼丝。
不断变化的迷宫：每次冒险都会迎来不同的迷宫，而迷宫深处隐藏着一个核心谜团。
多样化战斗方式：结合近战、剑术、枪械与魔法，积累力量并释放毁灭性的终结技。
丰富的角色构筑系统：通过战士记忆、神器、战斗精通与骰子打造专属流派。
双人在线合作：支持2人在线合作，并为每位玩家提供独立的奖励与成长进度。
开发团队寄语
“我们非常荣幸能够将柯南这样一位传奇英雄重新带回现代游戏世界。罗伯特·欧文·霍华德的故事对我们意义非凡，对于一代又一代的读者而言也是如此。我们将以应有的细致与尊重来对待这些作品。
https://image.gcores.com/3e3ac5ffc7c24109a7a8c45bd021c8eb-1920-1080.jpg
我们希望玩家能够真正踏入自己在阅读这些故事时所想象的世界，亲身感受其中原始、狂野而又充满奇异魅力的一切。”
—— Peter Nagy，Games Farm 首席执行官
“不可名状的恐怖、扭曲现实的魔法，以及来自其他世界的远古存在——这些鲜为人知的元素，恰恰是柯南世界中最令人着迷的部分之一，而玩家终于有机会亲身体验它们了。
柯南以及罗伯特·欧文·霍华德笔下的众多强大角色，都将在 Games Farm 团队的精心打造下焕发光彩。我们非常期待玩家能够亲自体验这些角色，并发现他们真正的魅力。”
—— Marcos Cronander，Heroic Signatures 总裁
游戏试玩报名现已开启
玩家现可通过 Steam 商店页面报名参与游戏试玩，首轮试玩即将开启。试玩名额将分批发放，而首批玩家提供的反馈，也将帮助我们决定游戏未来的开发方向。

news.title: 我已将 GTA 5 从犯罪模拟游戏转换为火车模拟游戏
news.summary: Choo choo.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

As we've already discussed, I regard the personal automobile as a vector of poisonous ideology . Its beneficent alternative? The train: socialised, communal, predictable, subject to the gentle yet firm hand of rational state planning. If the world had more trains in it, we wouldn't be where we are now. We'd be somewhere else. On account of catching the train.

I have converted Grand Theft Auto 5's Franklin Clinton into one of the hero-drivers of these great iron beasts. I have installed Los Santos Metro Driver , which transforms Rockstar's opus from crime sim to train sim. Or tram sim, I guess. Same thing. The city's denizens need to move between airport terminals and only man can help them do it (you are that man).

Did you know driving trains, like, sucks? It's hard. You'd think it'd be easy, what with being essentially glued to your surface of operation , but I have spent most of my career as a trainee train-er overshooting platforms, accidentally applying the emergency brake, and sometimes running over passengers. Which, whatever.

It is an almost alarmingly detailed simulation. You gather driver XP with which you ascend to new heights of train mastery. You are paid a wage. Your pay is docked if you overshoot stations. Crushing customers to paste doesn't seem to affect much.

Also, did you know train magic disrupts teleportation magic? My teleport-every-50-seconds mod remains in effect, the countdown timer glowing ominously on my screen in the midst of everything I do. And yet, somehow, while driving a train it is thwarted. It is a pleasant and newfound freedom, just one of the many positives of the train life.

news.title: 设定在美国境外的 GTA 怎么样？摇滚明星老板调侃道，“永不言败”，但不要屏住呼吸
news.summary: Rockstar isn't ruling out a GTA set outside the United States, but don't hold your breath: the studio says the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/02/gta-6-carjack-1793660725979.jpg
Rockstar isn't ruling out a GTA set outside the United States, but don't hold your breath: the studio says there are plenty more stories to tell in America.

In an interview with The Guardian , Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson was asked whether or not the developer would ever make a GTA game set outside of America. His response was simple: "Never say never." However, Nelson continued his response by stating, "There’s still so much to do in America."

The GTA series has largely rotated between three locations for the last 25 years: Liberty City (New York), Vice City (Miami), and San Andreas (California). We got a brief glimpse at the Midwest of GTA in GTA 5, when the game's story opened in a snowy state called North Yankton. But that's about as much as we've gotten outside of the coastal cities that GTA rotates through. It's unclear what else Rockstar wants to do with GTA, specifically the American setting.

GTA has flirted with going overseas before, as Rockstar came close to making one set in Japan in the early to mid-2000s . The first GTA also had an expansion set in London, and GTA 5 seemingly had scrapped DLC that would've at least partially taken place in Paris . Ex-GTA writer and creative director Dan Houser also stated last year that he doesn't think GTA would work as well outside of America .

"I think for a full GTA game, we always decided there was so much Americana inherent in the IP, it would be really hard to make it work in London or anywhere else," said Houser. "You know, you needed guns, you needed these larger-than-life characters. It just felt like the game was so much about America, possibly from an outsider's perspective. But that was so much about what the thing was that it wouldn't really have worked in the same way elsewhere.”
Maybe one day it will happen, but it does seem like Rockstar's interests with GTA are rooted in American culture.

GTA 6 will, of course, take us back to Vice City next week when it launches on November 19. It is expected to have one of the biggest launches in history, with it already being the most preordered game in the history of Xbox and PlayStation's digital stores . Players are able to preload the game right now , and they absolutely should, as the game is a whopping 210 GBs.

news.title: 漫威对手的创意总监解决了仇恨言论争议，并承诺“我们已经加强了纪律措施”
news.summary: A September incident that saw hate speech removed from the game's reporting system "sparked massive controvers

content.v: A few months ago Marvel Rivals became embroiled in one of the biggest controversies in its history when an error during an update ended up removing the "Hate Speech" option in its reporting system. This unfortunately led to a huge rise in slurs and hate speech within the game, and it also damaged the relationship between NetEase and players as many felt the studio wasn't doing enough to provide adequate safeguards for players .

Little was said about the issue at the time, although it was corrected fairly quickly and NetEase promised harsher penalties for toxic behaviour a few weeks later. Now Marvel Rivals' creative director Guangyun Chen has explained what exactly went wrong and what the team is doing to rectify the issue in a recent dev diary :
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/63JKawy8iZa6eETcv3EjVP-1920-80.png

"In mid September, while optimising our report system UI, we made a configuration error that caused the 'Hate Speech' option to be replaced by 'Crime'. The moment we discovered the issue, we fixed it immediately—it was an oversight on our part."

Mistakes happen, but what matters more is that NetEase is now trying to do more to combat hate speech in Marvel Rivals. "This incident sparked massive controversy in the community, and we realised right then that simply fixing a UI option wouldn't be enough to combat hate speech," Guangyun Chen says. "Because of this, we've entirely overhauled our penalty system for abusive language."

Starting on September 24, NetEase "ramped up our disciplinary measures," meaning that the "most severe offenders" will be met with a 365-day chat ban, something that players are overjoyed to see enacted . But he still reminds players that a healthy game environment also depends on the players—yeah, that's the problem.
"We strongly encourage everyone to report any toxic behaviour immediately," Guangyun Chen adds. "Our operations team verifies every report to ensure the appropriate penalties are applied."

news.title: 有 Synology NAS 吗？是时候检查您的更新了，因为两个高级漏洞可让不熟练者读写文件并进行 DDOS 攻击
news.summary: Big oof.

content.v: Another day, another cybersecurity update. This time, it's the turn of immensely popular NAS provider Synology to advise its users about some now-fixed gaping holes. The company has updated its DiskStation Manager (DSM) operating system , patching out two security vulnerabilities in various product versions.

Just another patch? Not quite. The first of these vulnerabilities has a CVSS3 base score of 9.8 out of 10, which makes it of "critical" severity (via International Cyber Digest on X ). According to the company:

"An improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command vulnerability in the Auth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)... allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks."

That's a pretty big security hole if I've ever seen one, particularly for those storing extremely important data on their home NAS setup. The second one gets a lower severity rating of 8.6, but also manages to allow attackers to skip the login process.

Synology describes the second vulnerability as "An authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the rsync in Synology DiskStation Manager," which can again lead to unwanted reads, writes, and DDOS shenanigans.

‼️BREAKING: A critical flaw in Synology NAS devices lets attackers read and write any file on them without logging in.The SQL injection bug in their login system scores 9.8 out of 10. A second flaw, in rsync, skips the login too.Synology patched both today. Update ASAP. https://t.co/LlS328SBf4 November 11, 2026

The company also notified users late last month of ransomware attacks related to a 2024 security advisory , for what looks to be a series of separate vulnerabilities. One way or the other, the latest updates look to have rolled out to many users already, but it's still worth checking to make sure you're on the newest builds to plug all these leaks.

After all, auto updaters are far from perfect. 2026 has been a year characterised by cybersecurity issues, and it'd really put the tin lid on it if your home NAS was broken into by some unscrupulous character. A reminder to keep on top of your updates no matter the device, methinks. Stay safe out there, folks.

news.title: 《魔兽世界永远》的第一个大秘密被玩家发现
news.summary: If there's one thing that's true about any version of World of Warcraft it's that Blizzard loves hiding convol

others.title: 《魔兽世界》：《永远》刚刚迎来了发布后的第一个重大变化

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/05/skybornethumb-1791225948395.png

If there's one thing that's true about any version of World of Warcraft, it's that Blizzard loves hiding convoluted quest chains behind mundane objects, the first of which has been found in WoW Forever.

If you've started a Skyborne character in Forever, you've probably completed a quest that rewarded you with an 'Ancient Heirloom' ring with no stats, and wondered why it even exists. Well, it turns out that it kicks off a whole hidden quest chain if you know where to look.

This secret was discovered by the WoW Secret Finding and Collections Discord , and it involves getting that ring, finding a sword hilt that only shows up when you're using a specific torch, then finding a blade with a random location and then finding and cleansing a 'Befouled Water Globe.' The community has put together a guide on Wowhead of the known steps so far, but there's a catch – it doesn't seem like anyone has actually finished the little scavenger hunt yet.

As of this morning, folks in the WoW Secret Finding Discord are still actively trying to see what gets unlocked at the end of this convoluted chain, but for now, the community is calling it the "Dawn Waker Secret" and seems to believe it revolves around a couple of swords: Eluvi'ana and Eluvi'tor.

As part of the process, you'll end up with a sword that you need to cleanse, and to do that, you'll need to clear the Capital Gardens section of Dire Maul and talk to Prince Tortheldrin, whose dialog hints that "such knowledge is reserved by those honored in my royal court." And, in classic WoW fashion, this probably means a lengthy rep grind is needed.

According to admin Miko in the WoW Secret Finding Discord, "Our most recent discoveries hint us that the rewards for this chain will involve the swords of Eluvi'ana and Eluvi'tor. The most recent step points us to a rep grind with the Shendralar Faction, as Prince Tortheldrin in Dire Maul tells us that only those Honored with his court are worthy enough to obtain the knowledge about these blades."

Depending on how long it takes players to actually get Honored with the Shendralar faction, it might be a while before the final reward is actually revealed. But there are hundreds of players in this Discord channel working on the secret, so it's only a matter of time.

We're still in the early days of WoW Forever, after all, and it's been a massively successful launch . And as more players start to get to max level , more secrets are sure to pop up in the world. After all, while World of Warcraft takes a lot of queues from Classic WoW, the developers have added a ton of content, so who knows how many secrets have been buried in the corners of Azeroth?

news.title: Steam 不断增加的审核积压导致另一款游戏的发布日期被推迟
news.summary: Steam's growing backlog for approving game builds appears to be getting worse, as yet another studio's game is

content.v: Steam's growing backlog for approving game builds appears to be getting worse, as yet another studio's game is stuck in the purgatory of the platform's review program. Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business , a post-apocalyptic game about keeping a cargo railway running after society has collapsed, was originally scheduled to launch on November 10, but it's stuck waiting for Steam's mandatory QA review before it can be published.

"Unfortunately, we're stuck waiting for Steam to review and approve our launch build. We have been waiting for a few weeks now and sadly don't know when they will finally get around to it," Australia Did It publisher Mystic Forge wrote in an update. "We're hoping to be able to launch as soon as possible and will update all of you the second we get an update. We really appreciate all of your continued support and apologize for the situation. We can't wait for you to check out the final game and hope to be able to get it into your hands soon!"

Australia Did It co-developer and game designer Rami Ismail said the game was originally submitted on October 20, and a minor controller issue caused it to fail. That bug was fixed the same day, but since then, Ismail and Aesthecian Labs have been stuck waiting for Steam approval.

"We've been in the queue again ever since, and have followed up with Valve several times to no result," Rami explained in an email to GameSpot. "The issue was that our in-game feedback functionality does not allow you to send feedback--from a keyboard text input--via controller. I'm used to this kind of hold-and-wait pattern on console, but not really on Steam. 10-14 days pre-launch is usually enough to fail twice over, and usually you only get failed on serious issues."

With reviews for Australia Did It already out, and the game on plenty of wishlists, not having it ready for its scheduled launch isn't doing it any favors. "Pre-emptively delaying the launch would've hurt, as did not doing so," Ismail added. "We decided to take that gamble and trust in Valve's willingness to come through for developers - it seems we bet wrong."

Is a deluge of AI slop to blame for Australia Did It being stuck in QA limbo? Ismail explained that Steam can set its own policies and host "slopware" games on its own servers, but it's also having a negative effect on developers.

"At 30% off of every game sold on the platform, I have to admit I don't really care what the reason is. It's likely slopware is a part of the issue, but the fact that slopware can exist on Steam is their own policy. Whatever the situation, Steam losing the agility and access for developers to launch with minimal friction will mean developers have to treat it more like a console - which means we have to be more careful about launches."

While releasing the game on another platform like the Epic Games Store could be one solution, Ismail noted that the "commercial potential" is much lower than on Steam, which accounts for the lion's share of PC game sales. "With Epic, we're just trading the one billionaire for the other, and the commercial potential is also much lower. For now we're stuck with Steam for commercial game releases."

Ordinarily, every game submitted to Steam undergoes a series of checks to ensure that it'll work on the launcher, a process that used to take a few days. Lately, multiple developers have been complaining that this process now takes up to two weeks, and in some instances, longer, as Steam is reportedly battling to work through a backlog of submitted games. Several studios have blamed a flood of AI slop games, which regularly fail QA and are then resubmitted for review, gumming up the works and creating a bottleneck.

Recently, Valve introduced new measures to help speed up the process, but it's unclear if they've had any real impact. Under the new guidelines, games submitted for QA are required to be run through the Steam launcher for a minimum of five minutes; there will be stricter enforcement on images so that players aren't misled; Steam will run automated checks to flag broken or incomplete achievements; and advertised features will need to be included.

content.v: All the cancelled projects and those that remain.

The current PS5 generation has seen the platform holder try to win the live service space, and a few years later, it's having to cancel most of the projects it revealed in attempting to achieve that.

To try and get a piece of the Fortnite pie, Sony made a hard and deliberate push into the Games as a Service space at the start of the PS5 generation. content.v: A step in the right direction?

After being leaked earlier this week, the European Commission has today presented its proposal for the ' Digital Fairness Act ' — a rule update that aims to offer "better protection for consumers and fairer competition for businesses" in the games industry.

To be clear, the proposal has not been adopted by the EU Commission just yet, but if it does go through, it could have a huge impact on several hot-topic game mechanics like loot boxes, virtual currencies, pay-to-win options and more. What's more, the act would apply to all EU member states without the need for individual approval.
